instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_029_variant_base_plate.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, a 140 x 120 x 8 mm base plate with a 20 mm center hole. Generate three variants from the same input: S has four 6 mm bolt holes on radius 30 mm, M has six 6 mm bolt holes on radius 38 mm, and L has eight 8 mm bolt holes on radius 46 mm. For each variant, place the bolt holes equally spaced around the center hole with the first hole on the +X axis. Keep the center hole and outer shape unchanged. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_029_variant_S.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_029_variant_M.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_029_variant_L.step. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). Run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_029_variant_base_plate.step`.
